title: Statistics until done
description:
Read numbers, one per line, until the user types `done`. Then print how many there were, their sum, their average with two decimals, and the largest:

```
Number (done to stop): 4
Number (done to stop): 10
Number (done to stop): 7.5
Number (done to stop): done
count 3
sum 21.5
average 7.17
largest 10
```

Numbers may have decimals; print the sum and the largest with the `g` format (`f"{x:g}"`), which drops a needless `.0`. Spaces around what is typed do not matter, and `DONE` works too. If no numbers were entered, print only `no numbers`.
hints: `while True:` with `break` when the line is `done` is the standard shape; collect the numbers in a list as you go.

examples.name: three numbers
examples.expected:
Number (done to stop): Number (done to stop): Number (done to stop): Number (done to stop): count 3
sum 21.5
average 7.17
largest 10

examples.name: negatives
examples.expected:
Number (done to stop): Number (done to stop): Number (done to stop): Number (done to stop): count 3
sum -6
average -2.00
largest -1

tests.expected:
